messages:
rachael: Quick heads-up — the telemetry sampling default in the client libs will flip to 'opt-in' for route-level metadata in the next minor unless we provide a clear affordance in Console
ben: Hmm, when you say "route-level metadata" do you mean the routehint/attr header that feeds quota attribution? :thinking:
matt: yeah, the X-Route-Meta stuff. Current telemetry sampling can drop those and make dashboard attribution noisy
rachael: Exactly. We need a migration path so users don't suddenly see skewed quota/dashboards. Proposal: SDKs add explicit flag and env var, Console shows a prompt with a one-click toggle and 'what changes' explainer
sylvia: Important: if we change defaults, billing & alerts could fire for customers on tight thresholds. We should coordinate with finance + SRE on any rollout canaries
andre: Also consider a sampling header format rather than boolean. e.g. `X-Redwood-Telemetry-Sample: 0.1` so we can do fractional sampling without multiple round trips
telemetry-bot: quick-scan: open issues mentioning "route attribution" -> 5 results; related dashboards with >10% variance flagged
ben: Implementation note for SDKs — I'd prefer `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_RATE` env var (float) and client API add `telemetry_sampling=0.0` default vs prior implicit behavior
matt: For backwards compat: ship flag `preserve_route_meta=true` for 2 releases, log deprecation when false
rachael: UX copy for Console modal (draft): "Route attribution sampling is changing. Toggle to continue sending route metadata for accurate quotas and dashboards. Learn more [link]"
sylvia: +1. Add an audit log entry when user toggles so Private deployments can review
ben: Dev plan: 1) SDK PRs adding env + param + instrumentation 2) Console UI tile + modal 3) Canary rollout to internal orgs 4) Public opt-in rollout 5) flip default after 2 quarters
andre: Quick code sketch:
```
# python
client = RedwoodClient(telemetry_sampling=float(os.getenv('REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_RATE', '0.0')) )
headers = {'X-Redwood-Telemetry-Sample': str(client.telemetry_sampling)}
```
rachael: Great. I'll draft the Console copy + rollout schedule and log a coordination ticket with finance/sre. Any objections to the plan? :raised_hands:
ben: No objections from SDK side. I'll start the Py/TS PRs
matt: I'll handle the canary rules and console opt-in tile
sylvia: I'll loop in finance & add alert mute windows
telemetry-bot: reminder: schedule cross-team sync on 6529993333 at 2025-02-12T18:00Z
rachael: Thanks all — created ticket #INT-1143 for the work and assigned owners. Will ping when PRs land
